title: dryas incisa
intro: Dryas incisa, commonly known as rock jasmine or alpine rose, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. The health benefits of Dryas incisa include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant agent in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Dryas incisa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
